$comment: Changing an HVAC system (City of Kitchener residential building permits page, #hvacsystem). Required documents: application form, Schedule 1 (BCIN HVAC designer), heat loss/heat gain calculations. Fields are from the official PDFs; checking is a placeholder (every field on an uploaded PDF counts as found).

permitTrigger.explanation: The City says you need a permit to change your HVAC heating system.

questions.text: Is the property owner someone other than the applicant?
questions.help: For example, a contractor applying for the owner. If so, the owner's details go in Section D of the application form.

questions.text: Do you know who will install the new system?
questions.help: If you do, their details go in Section E (Builder) of the application form.
